features.name: place-an-order.feature
features.text:
@checkout
Feature: Place an order
  As a customer
  I want to pay for the items in my basket
  So that they are shipped to me

  Background:
    Given the customer has a basket containing:
      | product      | qty | price |
      | Bamboo socks | 2   | £7.50 |
      | Gift wrap    | 1   | £4.99 |

  Scenario: Successful order
    When the customer places the order
    Then the order total is £19.99
    And the customer's card is charged £19.99
    And the stock for each item is reserved
    And a shipping note is sent to the warehouse
    And the customer receives an order confirmation

  Scenario: Item out of stock
    Given Bamboo socks are out of stock
    When the customer places the order
    Then the customer's card is not charged
    And the customer is told which items are unavailable

  Scenario Outline: Discount codes
    Given the customer enters the discount code "<code>"
    When the customer places the order
    Then the order total is <total>

    Examples:
      | code    | total  |
      | SAVE10  | £17.99 |
      | NOTREAL | £19.99 |

features.name: ship-an-order.feature
features.text:
@fulfilment
Feature: Ship an order
  As a warehouse operator
  I want to ship orders that have been paid for
  So that customers receive their items

  Background:
    Given a paid order containing:
      | product      | qty |
      | Bamboo socks | 2   |
      | Gift wrap    | 1   |

  Scenario: Pick and pack
    When the warehouse receives the shipping note
    Then the stock for each item is deducted
    And a parcel label is printed with the delivery address
    And the order status is "Packed"

  Scenario: Dispatch
    Given the parcel has been packed
    When the courier collects the parcel
    Then the order status is "Dispatched"
    And the customer receives a dispatch notification with a tracking number

features.name: return-an-item.feature
features.text:
@returns
Feature: Return an item
  As a customer
  I want to send back items I don't want
  So that I get my money back

  Background:
    Given a dispatched order containing:
      | product      | qty | price |
      | Bamboo socks | 2   | £7.50 |

  Scenario: Refund on return
    When the customer returns 1 pair of Bamboo socks
    Then the customer's card is refunded £7.50
    And the stock for Bamboo socks is increased by 1
    And the order status is "Partially returned"

  Scenario: Return window has closed
    Given the order was delivered 31 days ago
    When the customer tries to return the order
    Then the customer is told the return window has closed
    And the customer's card is not refunded
